products.name: Gaggle
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: AI flagging plus human review. Use: Student safety monitoring of school accounts. Who: District administrators, counselors. Student age: Monitors school-issued accounts of enrolled students. Privacy: District contract; human safety team reviews every flagged item before escalation, per vendor and district pages. Price: Reported from about $7 per account per year by a third party; confirm by quote. Caution: No evidence that monitoring prevents harm; see Chapter 15 notes.

profile_text.body:
Gaggle describes itself as offering K-12 student safety and mental wellness solutions, including AI-powered monitoring, web filtering, and coaching and therapy, for districts nationwide. Its site also describes ReachOut AI, which it says offers 24/7 emotional support for students ages 8 to 18 with human oversight. The company says Gaggle Safety Management uses human reviewers to examine every alert before it reaches a district team, and it frames its offerings as spanning prevention to detection.

The product record lists Gaggle under Education and Research AI, with use described as student safety monitoring of school accounts, aimed at district administrators and counselors. It monitors school-issued accounts of enrolled students. Privacy terms are handled through district contracts, and a human safety team reviews every flagged item before escalation, per vendor and district pages. Pricing was reported by a third party at about $7 per account per year, to be confirmed by quote. The record notes there is no evidence that monitoring prevents harm.

No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
